description: React component for a search input with clear button and optional shortcut hint, styled for different sizes.

methods.name: setRefs
methods.description: Sets the ref for the input element, supporting both callback and object refs.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, calling the onChange prop with the new value.

methods.name: handleClear
methods.description: Clears the input value and refocuses the input element.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating focus state and calling optional onFocus.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, updating focus state and calling optional onBlur.
